verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS commerce platform like Square, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI model training, data-use policies, or an opt-out control. The general claim about managing customer data securely is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
